items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: I was ready for Curtis at the age of 12.

ctx.x: No. That was the hardest thing actually. That’s the only instrument that I had lessons on actually, well other than that when I was eight years old I had lessons on a clarinet actually. There was a little Italian lodge and it was like three lessons a week and two © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
rehearsals for the concert and it was 33 dollars a month. And I was ready for Curtis at the age of 12.
